title: Studio S3 feasibility simulator: validation on SYNTHETIC worlds
disclaimer: Educational planning tool. Not financial, legal or lending advice. Lenders make their own decisions.
scope: Validation on SYNTHETIC worlds whose generator the same author wrote (src/uwcopilot/studio/feasibility/worlds.py and validation.py). It checks internal consistency and the effect of misspecification; it is not evidence of real-world accuracy.

dscr_target.label: lender policy (SYNTHETIC Northwind guideline NBC-4.2), editable
dscr_target.source: corpus/guidelines/northwind_business_credit.md NBC-4.2, term loan minimum decision DSCR (SYNTHETIC document of a fictional institution; also the NSP-4.1 threshold of the SYNTHETIC startup program)

method.worlds: worlds.py: each world draws a plan, a loan and a target one-forecast year-2 DSCR (uniform 0.6-2.4), then anchors it: the site's most likely demand is set so the one-forecast DSCR equals the target ('demand'); when the capacity mode cannot reach it, the founder gets a rent quote that does ('rent_quote'); worlds that reach it with neither lever are kept and counted ('none', n_worlds_not_anchored)
method.well_specified: the true path is one more draw from the simulator's own model
method.misspecified: the true path adds Student-t(3) monthly noise scaled to unit variance, a mean-one lognormal site demand error (log-sd 0.25), and with probability 0.3 a 6-month downturn cutting demand by a uniform 0.2-0.5 share
method.band_coverage: share of the 36 months whose true value lies within the forecast P10-P90 (inclusive), averaged over worlds (one true future per world)
method.expected_band_coverage: the same with 100 extra true futures per world (independent random stream); removes the noise of one future per world (a diagnostic)

coverage_reference_if_well_specified.formula: 0.8 x (n - 1) / (n + 1) for n forecast paths: the share of new draws expected inside a P10-P90 band estimated from n samples with NumPy's linear interpolation

method.probability_gap: mean over worlds of |forecast probability - true probability|, where the true probability is the share of the 100 extra true futures with the outcome; it includes the Monte Carlo noise of both shares (a diagnostic)
method.brier: mean of (forecast probability - true 0/1 outcome)^2 over worlds; lower is better
method.single_forecast_baseline: every input at its most likely value, no shocks, no noise; read as a yes (1) or no (0) forecast (single_forecast_yes_rate = share of worlds where it says yes)
method.base_rate_baseline: a constant forecast equal to the share of the same worlds with the outcome (in-sample, so it is optimistic)

timing.note: wall time on a shared 4-CPU machine used by several agents at once; see provenance.environment for the load average at the start and the end of the run

example_run.note: SYNTHETIC validation world 0 of this business type (worlds.py); not a real site or plan

loan.rate_source: prime rate 6.25% (SYNTHETIC: SYNTHETIC prime rate of the generated city; NOT a published rate) + 3.0 points (spread is the ASSUMPTION mode (Not a lender quote. Replace with the lender's term sheet; the founder can type the quoted rate instead.))

break_even.definition: first month starting 3 months in a row with net income (NOI - debt service) >= 0

example_run.tornado_metric: year-2 net income (NOI minus debt service), P50 across paths, USD

tornado_top_five.name: mature_demand
tornado_top_five.description: Demand at the site once ramp-up is over (before seasonality)

tornado_top_five.name: cost_ratio_utilities
tornado_top_five.description: utilities cost as a share of revenue

stress.name: revenue_stress
stress.description: Revenue 20% lower, NOI lower by the same dollars
stress.reason: applied to every month of every simulated path, and to the year-2 P50 the lender's way
stress.source: SYNTHETIC Northwind guideline NBC-4.5 (applied to startup loans by NSP-4.2 of the SYNTHETIC startup program); levers and thresholds imported from agent/policy_credit.py

stress.name: rate_stress
stress.description: Note rate 2.00 points higher for the whole loan
stress.reason: applied to every month of every simulated path, and to the year-2 P50 the lender's way
stress.source: SYNTHETIC Northwind guideline NBC-4.5 (applied to startup loans by NSP-4.2 of the SYNTHETIC startup program); levers and thresholds imported from agent/policy_credit.py
